scripts.name: STRATUS - EKS - Create Admin EKS Access Entry
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for Amazon EKS.

Create Admin EKS Access Entry

Uses the EKS Cluster Access Management to assign cluster administrator privileges to an IAM role. This allows the role to perform any action inside the Kubernetes cluster. Warm-up: - Create an IAM role Detonation: - Create an access entry for the IAM role - Associate the access entry with the

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Create Admin EKS Access Entry
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_kube_context}" ]; then KUBE_ARGS="--kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/config"; fi
if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_profile}" ]; then export AWS_PROFILE="#{stratus_aws_profile}"; fi
if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_region}" ]; then export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="#{stratus_aws_region}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=eks.lateral-movement.create-access-entry"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate eks.lateral-movement.create-access-entry
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=eks.lateral-movement.create-access-entry"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"eks.lateral-movement.create-access-entry\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup eks.lateral-movement.create-access-entry
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=eks.lateral-movement.create-access-entry"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT
